{{Quote|But what can we do?|Unidentified reptilian Jedi trainee|<ref name="Darksaber (novel)">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
This '''reptilian Jedi trainee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] student at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. She was present at a meeting inside the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] that was held just after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began an [[Assault on Yavin 4|attack]] on the academy, to decide what the Jedi could do. As [[Dorsk 81]] began talking about how the Jedi could increase their powers by working together, she asked him what they could actually do against the Imperial threat and he explained to her that the Jedi could use the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi temples]] to focus their combined powers and move the attacking [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] away.
